pwnedProject.title: Pwned Password Check
pwnedProject.desc: Check whether a password has appeared in data breaches. The backend uses the k-Anonymity method with Have I Been Pwned, so the full password is never sent.
pwnedProject.archDesc: The backend exposes an API endpoint that accepts a password, generates its SHA-1 hash, and communicates with the HaveIBeenPwned API to check whether the password has appeared in data breaches.
pwnedProject.how1: The backend calculates the SHA-1 hash of the password and sends only the first 5 characters to the API.
pwnedProject.how2: HaveIBeenPwned returns a list of matching hashes and the number of times they appear.
pwnedProject.how3: The backend compares the remaining part of the hash locally and returns the result.

imageEditor.title: Image Editor (Python API)
imageEditor.desc: API for image processing with file upload, resizing, grayscale conversion, rotation, and downloading the final PNG file.
imageEditor.archDesc: The project consists of a Python backend that handles file uploads and image processing operations such as resizing, grayscale conversion, and rotation. The operations are performed on the API side, and the frontend displays the result as a preview before the file is downloaded.
imageEditor.hint: Choose an image to start editing.

errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.

imageClassifier.title: Image Classifier (ML)
imageClassifier.desc: Backend API for image classification using a machine learning model. The API accepts an image, processes it with the ML model, and returns the most probable categories along with the results in JSON format.
imageClassifier.archDesc: The backend exposes an API endpoint that accepts an image uploaded by the user, prepares it for prediction (preprocessing), and then passes it to the machine learning model. The model returns a list of the most probable classes along with their assigned probabilities, which the API returns in a JSON response.
imageClassifier.warningDesc: The first run of the classifier may take a few seconds. The ML model is loaded only when a request is made, which reduces memory usage in the hosting environment.
imageClassifier.smartTip: Smart mode uses a broad pool of general categories available on the backend side. You don’t need to type anything.
imageClassifier.presetsError: Could not load presets from the API.
imageClassifier.manualTip: Manual mode: type your own labels (comma-separated). CLIP matches image to text.

auth.title: Auth & User Management API
auth.desc: Backend API for authentication and user management built with FastAPI. The project implements JWT login, password hashing, user roles, and integration with a PostgreSQL database.
auth.archDesc: The project consists of a FastAPI backend that handles user registration, login, and access to protected endpoints. User data is stored in a PostgreSQL database using SQLAlchemy, and passwords are secured with bcrypt hashing. After successful login, the backend generates a JWT token used to authorize subsequent requests, and access to selected resources is controlled based on the user’s role, such as admin or user.
